# True IPTV Subscription

> True IPTV Subscription is an IPTV subscription service offering live TV channels (Sports, News, Kids, Local) plus a curated library of Movies & TV Shows (VOD), in 4K and Full HD, with a free 24-hour trial, a program guide (EPG), 24/7 WhatsApp support, and a pay-only-after-confirmed-working model. Plans range from 1 to 12 months, supporting 1-5 simultaneous devices (more available on request). Operated by the team behind TruWave TV.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://trueiptvsubscription.com/): overview, channel categories, pricing, FAQ
- [Plans](https://trueiptvsubscription.com/plans/): pricing by term (1/3/6/12 months), multi-device pricing
- [Apps](https://trueiptvsubscription.com/apps/): comparison of compatible player apps
- [Devices](https://trueiptvsubscription.com/devices/): device compatibility guide
- [Guides](https://trueiptvsubscription.com/guides/): setup and troubleshooting guides
